snippet.title: QuestAway - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play QuestAway FREE on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5195600/

A tiny idle RPG that lives next to your taskbar. Build a party of heroes, send them off to fight and get back to work. When you come back, the loot is waiting.

- Free to play
- Your party fights on its own while you do other things
- Equip what drops, spend your points and send them somewhere harder
- Resize the arena from 0.5x to 1.5x to fit next to your taskbar

Wishlist and follow QuestAway on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5195600/

Made by Art X Games.
